response.original_title: Hugo Blanco y el periódico Lucha Indígena
response.overview: A short documentary about the work of the editors of *LUCHA INDÍGENA*, the only print publication in Peru that reports on all attacks against nature by transnational corporations and on the struggles of Indigenous peoples worldwide, as well as those of rural and urban populations in present-day Peru.
